entry.name: The predicted cost at the solution stage, read from the delivered kpi.json records, reporting and never refusing
entry.red: A solution advance carries a forecast whose per-slice figure comes from the delivered slices' output tokens and not from the plan's points, names the split when it exceeds the session budget, and reports `available: false` with both counts rather than a low figure when fewer tickets have delivered than `[calibration] window`.
